## Featured work

- ResumeLens ATS: AI-assisted resume and job-description analysis.
- AI Gym Coach: camera-based exercise tracking and voice coaching.
- Eureka: multi-source paper and conference discovery with TF-IDF retrieval, deduplication, bookmarks, and CSV exports. Source repository: https://github.com/yajask-maker/Webscrap_proj_Sem5
- SceneDNA: reference-image analysis, reusable visual blueprints, and prompt variations using Gemini.

## More projects

- StockSense: explainable stock-direction modeling.
- MedSimplify: OCR and biomedical NLP for readable medical reports.
- YouTube Video Analyser: summaries, timestamped notes, study guides, and Markdown reports from public YouTube videos.
- Spotify Analytics: interactive music-data exploration.
